date-range-box.$description: DateRangeBox: two masked inputs with a separator, the calendars and the presets on a popup.

popup-gap.$description: Between the calendars, and the presets beside them.

field.$description: The field under a range box: two dates wide.

separator.$description: The glyph between the start and the end (`icon` its shape, `bg` its colour).

presets.$description: The list of ready-made ranges on the popup (its ring under the keys drawn inside it: it scrolls); `beside`: next to the calendars (the space and the line between them at its start).
